title: Quarterly account review 1:1 - prep & follow-ups (ACME Corp)
content:
Meeting context:
- Purpose: prep for 1:1 with AE (Marco) + SE (Sana) to align next steps for ACME Corp renewal conversation and address recent latency regressions.
- When: 2026-03-14 10:00 PT (30m).
- Audience: Marco (AE) owns account ops/contract, Sana (SE) on technical owner, me (CSM) for health/advocacy.

Account snapshot (quick):
- Plan: Production (reserved) - Dedicated medium GPU pool.
- ARR: ~$420k ARR; renewal due 2026-06-01.
- Primary workloads: chat+api for buyer chatbot, embeddings for semantic search.
- Notable: Enabled prefix caching in Jan; started rollout of model-variant v2-q8 in Feb.

Key metrics (last 30d):
- Monthly API tokens: 3.1B tokens (up 8% m/m)
- Embedding calls: 240k calls (flat)
- Avg P95 latency (chat): 420ms (target 300ms) -> latency increased since v2-q8 rollout
- Error rate (5xx): 0.8% (baseline <0.3%)
- Billing variance: +12% vs committed usage (edge of overage threshold)

Risk signals / red flags to mention:
- Latency regressions post-quant rollout (users noticed slower response times during peak).
- Production errors clustered around 11:00-13:00 PT (coincides w/ batch job).
- Customer finance flagged spend trend; AE concerned about renewal pricing friction.
- Two product feedback threads open about hallucination rate for product-search responses.

Agenda (30m):
1) Quick sync on customer posture (2m) - who speaks what.
2) Share the metrics & incidents (5m) - highlight P95 and 5xx windows.
3) Technical triage plan + proposal (8m) - Sana to propose short/med term fixes.
4) Commercial / renewal strategy (8m) - Marco to discuss concessions/thresholds.
5) Action items & owners (5m) - confirm next steps and comm plan.

Talking points / script (notes to self):
- Open: "Quick pulse — overall health is decent but we need to address latency & spend to secure renewal."
- Emphasize: "We want to keep their product stable and predictable; we own the rollback/fallback plan."
- Ask AE: "What would make the renewal conversation straightforward? What threshold for spend/latency triggers escalations on their side?"
- Ask SE: "Can we roll a quick rollback to the previous model variant for the high-traffic routes? If not, what's the fastest mitigation?"

Technical quick checklist for SE (Sana):
- Reproduce tail-latency via load replay (INF-4321).
- Inspect KV cache hit rates for top routes (buyer-chat prefix).
- Validate autoscaler policy around 11:00-13:00 PT.
- Suggest immediate mitigation: temporarily pin to v2-fp16 for chat-route-1; enable stricter batching window for embeddings.

Commercial / AE notes (Marco):
- Renewal target: same ARR with +10% price increase if we hit SLA guarantees (P95 < 350ms and <0.3% errors).
- Possible concession: one-month free overage buffer + 3-month price hold if we meet targets by 2026-05-01.
- Upsell angle: move additional product search traffic into dedicated pool for lower latency (estimate +$70k ARR).

Open questions to surface in meeting:
- Does ACME have internal spikes (campaigns) not in our telemetry? Confirm with AE.
- Any legal/contract constraints for rolling back models? (finance/legal sign-off timelines).
- Is there appetite for a short pilot of our Optimize suggestions (batch windows + kv cache TTL adjustments)?

Draft action items (concrete - confirm owner/due):
- Action: Sana to open a load-replay job and post initial findings to INF-4321 by 2026-03-18.
- Action: Ethan (me) to compile a 1-pager for ACME execs summarizing risks, proposed fixes, and timeline by 2026-03-17.
- Action: Marco to surface renewal KPI thresholds and finance contact; confirm if they need an invoice cadence change by 2026-03-20.
- Action: Product (cc: Raj) to review hallucination examples and comment on model-behavior tickets by 2026-03-25 (linked: confluence/ACME-quarterly-review).
- Action: If rollback is approved, Infra to schedule rollback window and notify ACME by 2026-03-21 (ticket: INF-4332).

Notes-to-self / meeting reminders:
- Bring concrete numbers (P95 trend chart last 6 weeks) — attach to 1-pager.
- Remind Marco that customer values response predictability more than occasional lower latency.
- Don't overpromise timeline for model-behavior fixes; propose phased mitigations.

Parking lot / longer-term asks:
- Proposal: Offer ACME a "performance workshop" w/ dedicated SRE session (2 days) to optimize batching/quant configs ($5k small fee or included in renewal concession).
- Investigate whether we can offer a usage cap alert that pauses non-critical pipelines to avoid overage bursts.

Conversation snippets to use (quick):
- "We 100% own this with you — here's what we can do in 48hrs, here's what we need 2–4 weeks for."
- "If you want, we can run a targeted rollback to verify delta quickly and measure impact before making a commercial ask."

Final checklist before meeting:
- [ ] Attach P95/time chart (dash link).
- [ ] Confirm Marco & Sana calendar invites.
- [ ] Publish meeting note template in confluence/ACME-quarterly-review and link to customer thread.
- [ ] Prep 1-pager PDF.

After-meeting follow-up template (send within 24h):
Subject: ACME 1:1 recap + agreed next steps
Body: short one-liner (health + top risk), list of action items w/ owners and due dates (copy from meeting), next sync date.

Last-minute thoughts: keep tone collaborative, prioritize short wins to build confidence ahead of renewal.

-- End of scratchpad --
